'''Morgan Crigger''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Tennessee State Championship]] on 8 April 2000 with Asteroid Sanctuary Odds, according to Jim Sells's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d501">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-yet-another-tennessee-reportd501/ yet-another-tennessee-report], DeckTech (Jim "NewJedi00" Sells, 10 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-10-yet-another-tennessee-reportd501/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
